A '''philosopher''' hailed from<ref name="Insider144" /> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] region<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Nouane (Allied Region)|Nouane]].<ref name="Insider144" /> At one point by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="HondoDate">{{HondoOhnakaScoreDate}}</ref> he was traveling aboard a [[Luxury liner/Legends|starliner]] when he was kidnapped by [[Sabo/Legends|Sabo]], a member of a [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|gang]] of [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] led by [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] and based out of<ref name="Insider144" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]].<ref name="SWE">{{SWE|locations|florrum|Florrum}}</ref> Ohnaka subsequently informed Sabo that someone's eloquence did not necessarily imply that they possessed any [[Currency/Legends|money]]. Eventually, the [[Philosopher/Legends|philosopher's]] talk, which Ohnaka considered "babbling," annoyed the pirates enough for them to throw him into a hole with a dangerous creature known as [[Gundark/Legends|gundark]].<ref name="Insider144" />

Later, while a hung-over Ohnaka was aboard the [[C-One liner|luxury liner]] ''[[Salin Mariner]]'', he was reminded of the philosopher during a conversation about [[Saffa paintings|art]] after he had given an annoyed advice to a group of other first-class passengers about using a gundark to deal with complaints from employees. At the time, the pirate also unsuccessfully tried to remember the philosopher's name.<ref name="Insider144" />

==Behind the scenes==
The philosopher was mentioned in [[Jason Fry]]'s short story "[[Hondo Ohnaka's Not-So-Big Score]]," which was published in the [[Star Wars Insider 144|144th issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="Insider144" /> on [[September 3]], [[2013]].<ref name="Insider144Date">[[Star Wars Insider 143|''Star Wars Insider'' 143]]</ref>
